dimension_specs: A live worker channel draft changes original offline/FD/authentication loss boundaries;retention options cannot silently borrow it.
Host writer and clock exclusions need one explicit consistent trust/source scope;code/path/hash/namespace do not prove protected consumed objects.
Guardian survival,known complete descendants/FD/in-flight drain and absorbing failure stop must compose under actual finite rights.
Claim/launch/action spend,unknown ACK,no replay and trusted forward/recovery deadlines must remain jointly exact.
Known full target facts cannot be substituted by unknown backups or summarized backend effects;every safe restore/no-write branch retains all original gates.
Changed producer/receipt membership requires explicit migration of full stage12 and every observer own effect/oracle/custody obligation;acyclic paper order proves no native closure.
A separate component product cannot satisfy current whole-entry/Phase1 proof/case/entry/readiness scope without full approved migration.
No observer/injector/consumer exception;actual origin,writers,finite rights,storage,stream and ACK/custody outcomes remain due.
Whole independently safe actual composition review precedes separate fresh explicit native-test grant;native conformance later operational readiness. No historical/other-platform transfer.
